name: Emery Beauty Bar
address_raw: 900 SW Pine Island Rd Suite 209, Cape Coral, FL 33993
about: Our mission at Emery Beauty Bar is to safely produce natural looking results while providing a quality experience. We strive for excellence in each and every service to consistently exceed all clients expectations. Enhancing your beauty but also reminding you of yours!

reviews.author: Seline Shipman
reviews.text: I had gotten a service done with Asma which required me to be vulnerable with my body and she was super welcoming and made me feel comfortable, it almost felt like I had known her for years!

reviews.author: Haley Hernandez
reviews.text: Asma is so sweet and very professional. My facial was absolutely amazing! She pays great attention to detail and really listens to your skincare needs.

reviews.author: Rosario Rivas
reviews.text: I had such a great experience at Emery Beauty Bar! Asma did an amazing job on my brows, they look perfect. The studio is clean, welcoming, and professional.

reviews.author: Barbie Smith
reviews.text: Highly recommend Asma! Her work is awesome and she has a great personality. I visited her for a full eyebrow lamination service and she beyond met my expectations.

reviews.author: Nilda Rodriguez
reviews.text: Every time I go in for an eyebrow wax, she gets them perfect: clean, natural, and shaped in a way that truly fits my face. She's gentle, detailed, and makes the whole experience so comfortable.
reviews.note: Original quote used an em-dash; typographic punctuation normalized to a colon here for the record. Not used on site (kept to 4 quotes without needing to touch original punctuation).
